## Governance

This section describes governance arrangements for sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities. The disclosures in this section are limited to information available in the reporting dataset.

changes_made.details: Removed generic, requirement-parroting statements and bullet lists that asserted disclosures without providing entity-specific, evidence-supported content.

Did not add names of governance bodies/individuals, committees, reporting cadence, controls, targets, metrics, remuneration linkages, or policy references because none were provided as evidence in the allowed context.
Removed duplicated sustainability vs. climate governance subsections that repeated the same unsupported template content.

claim_updates.reason: No evidence in allowed context identifying governance body/individuals or linking responsibilities to terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies.
No evidence describing skills/competency assessment or development for sustainability oversight.
No evidence describing how/how often governance bodies are informed about sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
No evidence describing how sustainability-related risks/opportunities are considered in strategy, major transactions, risk management, or trade-offs.
No evidence of target-setting oversight, monitoring, metrics, or remuneration linkage for sustainability-related matters.
No evidence naming a management position/committee or describing oversight mechanisms for sustainability governance.
No evidence describing management controls/procedures or integration with internal functions for sustainability oversight.
No evidence identifying governance body/individuals for climate oversight or linking responsibilities to governance documents/policies.
No evidence describing climate-specific skills/competency assessment or development.
No evidence describing how/how often governance bodies are informed about climate-related risks and opportunities.
No evidence describing how climate-related risks/opportunities are considered in strategy, major transactions, risk management, or trade-offs.
No evidence of climate target-setting oversight, monitoring, metrics, or remuneration linkage.
No evidence naming a management position/committee or describing oversight mechanisms for climate governance.

critical_rules_alignment: Write only evidence-supported disclosures: complied by removing unsupported assertions.
Do not discuss absent/omitted items in report prose: complied by keeping the revised section high-level and non-committal.
remaining_gaps_for_data_owner: Identify the governance body(ies)/individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities and cite the relevant terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies.
Describe how the governance body is informed (channels and frequency) and how it assesses skills/competencies.
Describe how sustainability/climate matters are considered in strategy, major transactions, and risk management, including trade-offs.
Describe target-setting oversight, monitoring, and any remuneration linkage.
Identify management roles/committees and describe controls/procedures and integration with internal functions.
